title: Unify reusable failure-preserving test teardown across test projects
outcome: Success-gated process and workspace cleanup is shared through TestSupport and always completes remaining client, daemon, coordination-file, lease, and workspace teardown before surfacing the first cleanup failure.
acceptance: A client-disposal failure cannot bypass remaining client disposal, keep-alive daemon retirement, runtime-mode restoration, or temporary-tree cleanup.
A lease-release assertion failure still executes workspace cleanup while preserving the assertion failure.
Cleanup helpers needed by IndexTests, LifecycleTests, GitTests, WatcherTests, and CodeNav.Tests live in tests/TestSupport and are linked where required.
Process kill failures cannot bypass portal coordination-file cleanup or replace an earlier test-body failure.
